description: This file contains API client functions for a frontend dashboard, including functions to resolve API base URLs, fetch module overviews, and retrieve overview metrics. It also exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with error handling and content-type checking.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if necessary.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the dashboard overview screen.
